steps.title: Bring mice to analysis room
steps.instruction: Bring the mice to the analysis room 30 minutes (00:30:00) before the start of the analysis.

steps.title: Place mice in clean cages
steps.instruction: Remove each animal from its home cage, place it in a clean plastic cage with a lid, and keep the mouse without food or water for 1 hour (01:00:00).

steps.title: Record pellet number
steps.instruction: Take a picture of the cage bottom to record the number of pellets produced.

steps.title: Collect stools in sealed tubes
steps.instruction: Collect stools immediately after they are produced and place them in sealed tubes.

steps.title: Weigh and dry stools
steps.instruction: At the end of the trial, count and weigh the fresh stools (total weight). Then dry the sealed tubes overnight for 18 hours (18:00:00) at 65 °C, weigh the dried stools again to obtain dry weight, and take a picture of the tubes with the dry stools visible.

substeps.instruction: Dry the tubes overnight (18 h) at 65 °C.
Photograph the tubes with dry stools.

steps.title: Calculate moisture and incidence
steps.instruction: Calculate stool water content as [(A‑B)/A] × 100, where A = weight of fresh stools minus the average weight of an empty Eppendorf tube (0.94 g) and B = weight of dried stools minus 0.94 g. Then calculate incidence rate = (number of constipated mice ÷ total analyzed mice) × 100.

substeps.instruction: Compute moisture content using the formula.
Compute incidence rate using the formula.

steps.title: Repeat experiment twice weekly
steps.instruction: Repeat the entire experiment two times per week and average the values for each mouse for statistical analysis.

steps.title: Return mice to home cage
steps.instruction: After the testing period, transfer the mice back to their home cage.
